decisions: Project listings mix current and historical work. English and German TU pages disagree on AMADEUS, BioProBot and Mushlabs; no current/completed status is asserted for these projects.
FIERCE has an explicit May 2023–April 2026 period on its own project page, despite appearing under running projects in the group overview. Its dates are shown without claiming an extension.
The original KIWI Future Lab is presented as project history rather than an ongoing four-year funding award.

Nicolas Cruz Bournazou is described as group lead on the institutional group page; Peter Neubauer is described as co-founder and director in the dated April 2026 institutional article. These distinct source roles are retained.
The archive roster is historical and does not establish present employment. Only people explicitly labeled former members in the original site are presented as former members.
Archived dates without a year remain undated. Expired meeting and registration links are removed.
The linked bibliography has no post-2023 publications; no newer publication dates were invented.
Source photography is used unchanged; layout, size and crops are controlled with CSS. Missing archive images are omitted without fabricating replacements.
The site identity uses the exact green KIWI-biolab logo supplied by the site owner on 11 September 2026.

89 source image files were recovered. Eleven assets returned 404 from both the archive and original host: two microscopy figures, two network logos and seven older seminar portraits. Available alternate sizes were checked; the corresponding text remains available.

Two publication years were corrected using the linked institutional bibliography: DOI 10.1002/bit.28236 to 2022 and DOI 10.1016/j.compchemeng.2023.108158 to 2023. The original citations are retained in the content data.
